HOW IT WORKS
Pick a plan and Shiver tells you exactly what to do that day: how long to stay warm, how long to finish cold, and when each phase changes — announced with haptics and a chime so you never have to open your eyes or step out of the spray to check a clock.

SIX GRADUATED PLANS
- 14-Day Starter (free) — the beginner ramp: a cold finish that grows from 15 seconds to 90 over two weeks
- 30-Day Full Cold — the warm-up shrinks away while the cold grows to a full 4 minutes, fully cold by day 13
- Contrast Protocol — 14 days of hot/cold intervals, always ending cold
- 11-Minute Week — four sessions a week totalling 11 cold minutes, with rest days built in
- 90-Day Ice Ladder — a slow three-month climb from 30 seconds to 5 minutes of cold, with a weekly rest day through week 12
- The Reset — a 7-day comeback ramp for after a broken streak, from 15 seconds back to 2 fully cold minutes

Before your first session Shiver walks you through the cold-shock response, the conditions worth checking with a doctor about first, and the signs that mean stop right away — written in plain language, never buried, always one tap away in Settings. Shiver only ever measures you against your own past sessions, never against anyone else.

TRACK WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED
A completed session logs itself — duration, cold time, and plan day — then you add how it felt: mood before and after, and a 1-to-5 snowflake cold rating. Watch it build into a streak and a calendar heatmap.
